scope: Product evidence intake, background enrichment and deterministic load intelligence; no runtime imports or compatibility approvals

localTrialPolicy.freeExternalEnrichment: Optional only, subject to access and reuse terms; not an acceptance prerequisite
localTrialPolicy.paidProviderChoices: Documented future options; deferred for local trial
localTrialPolicy.acceptanceHandoff: Product identification/source research complete; main controller reconciles delivery status. Physical package, machine and phone/laundry acceptance remain distinct.

invariants: Retain original user references and leading zeros in product identifiers
Barcode identity is not package revision, dosing evidence or compatibility approval
Owned products are not automatically selected additives
A selected product cannot disappear silently to make a plan pass
Missing ingredient disclosure is not verified ingredient absence
No invented concentration, pH, cap-to-volume, scoop-to-mass or Pak-to-water ratio
Shared executable instructions require reviewed source-backed conditions
No external retrieval, OCR or model call in routine load evaluation
No all-product subset precomputation or universal pairwise compatibility table
Evaluate aggregate and stage-sequence constraints as well as selected pairs
Benefit and personal outcomes do not override label or garment restrictions
Private user photos and outcomes are not automatically contributed publicly
Source access, storage, redistribution and deletion rights are separate from technical reachability

cacheDesign.refreshBehavior: New evidence creates candidates; pinned revisions do not silently change; active safety revocation invalidates derived plans

performanceTargets.notes: Chemistry-only timing excludes input retrieval; warm preview includes backend/planner/render and supported network. Benchmark before claiming performance.

acceptanceCases.expected: Disambiguate pack, market and label revision even after barcode hit
Free and scented variants, powder and Paks remain distinct
No substitution of later master-label doses or cap sizes
Preserve invalid CAS source text and quarantine identifier; no silent repair
Explicit unavailable evidence; no inferred SDS content
Not listed is not verified absence
Unsupported presoak route unavailable; independently supported wash route retained
Apply the reviewed bleach restriction without guessing that stage separation resolves it
No automatic Downy/Lysol combination or invented dose split
Unsupported rinse contact time cannot produce a sanitizing claim
No treatment or blocker solely from ownership
Specific question or explicit leave-out choice; no silent omission
Whole treatment set and sequence evaluated beyond pairwise checks
Idempotent bounded retry after duplicate, disconnect, timeout or expired lease
Correct bundle/plan invalidation and preserved independently permitted history
No private photo, status, outcome or cache leakage across households
Same versioned inputs yield same result with zero external/model calls
